vendor.blurb: Hunyuan rebuilt as Hy: all LLMs Apache-licensed, deployed via Yuanbao and WeChat

hy4-preview.tagline: First flagship to help optimize its own training
highlights: 163 internal experts' blind eval 2.99/4, edging Kimi K3 and GLM-5.3
Terminal-Bench 2.1 85.4, DeepSWE 64.3
Self-optimized its inference stack: end-to-end throughput +31.8%
Among the cheapest flagship open weights; listed on OpenRouter
hy4-preview.notes: No AA Intelligence Index or LMArena results yet. The lead comes from Tencent's own blind eval; on public benchmarks it trails Opus 5 and GPT-5.6. Placed in tier A on the reference ladder.

benchName.腾讯内部盲评（203 个工程任务）: Tencent internal blind eval (203 engineering tasks)

hy3.tagline: The workhorse behind Tencent's app family
highlights: AA Intelligence Index 25
LMArena Text 1457, roughly #62
Wired into Yuanbao, ima, QQ Browser, WeChat Official Accounts, CodeBuddy and more
Apache 2.0, fast/slow thinking fused
hy3.notes: Hy3 preview shipped in late April; the final version arrived in July. Placed in tier C on the reference ladder.

hy3-preview.tagline: The first release after the Hunyuan rebuild
highlights: First model after Hunyuan's reorg, focused on practicality and agents
LMArena Text 1409, roughly #145
Replaced by the final Hy3 after 3 months
hy3-preview.notes: Superseded by the final Hy3; kept only to show the version history.

hy-image-3.5-preview.tagline: Thinks before it draws, and it's cheap
highlights: Human-eval win rate up 30% over Hy Image 3.0, per Tencent
One model for text-to-image and image-to-image; up to 5 references, 2K output
Tencent says it costs 1/8.8 of GPT Image 2
Available on ComfyUI, OnSolo and GMI Cloud
hy-image-3.5-preview.notes: Not yet in the top 30 of LMArena or AA image boards. Tier is set from the previous generation's ranking plus the self-reported gain, without upgrading it.

hunyuanimage-3.0.tagline: One of the biggest open multimodal image models
highlights: 80B MoE native multimodal architecture, open weights
Instruct version (2026-01) adds chain-of-thought reasoning and image-to-image
LMArena Image Edit 1302, roughly #23, 300K+ votes
hunyuanimage-3.0.notes: Text-to-image is not in the top 30 of LMArena or AA. Edit score is on par with Seedream 4.5.

hunyuanvideo-1.5.tagline: Open video model that runs on a consumer GPU
highlights: 8.3B parameters, native 480p/720p, up to 1080p via super-resolution
Step-distilled I2V runs 75% faster on an RTX 4090
Open training code and LoRA fine-tuning scripts
hunyuanvideo-1.5.notes: Not in the top 30 of LMArena or AA video boards. Tencent currently has no video model that competes with closed frontier ones like Seedance or Veo; a rumored HunyuanVideo 2.0 is unconfirmed.
